panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (a, b). a: Pre-contrast coronal MRI of a patient with bilateral Tolosa-Hunt syndrome. The caption states white arrows mark pathological infiltrate involving both cavernous sinuses, which is a Tolosa-Hunt manifestation supported by the disease-focused article title. The central black-arrow pituitary lesion is noted as a proposed finding, but attribution rests on the bilateral cavernous sinus infiltrate. [raw subtype: bilateral] b: Post-contrast coronal MRI of the same patient with bilateral Tolosa-Hunt syndrome. Contrast administration demonstrates the enhancing infiltrate involving both cavernous sinuses (white arrows), directly matching the configured MRI finding. Bilateral cavernous sinus involvement is a less common, hence variant, presentation; disease attribution is supported by the article title and captioned manifestation. [raw subtype: bilateral]
